free_tier.stated: Free tunnel (registered users): permanently free, 1M bandwidth, 2 GB traffic per month, HTTP/TCP/UDP tunnels, random domain or random TCP/UDP port, forced domain/port change at intervals. [translated]

egress.terms: 2 GB per month on the free tunnel.; ingress: udp
egress.free_allowance: 2 GB per month on the free tunnel.

record.interface_detail: Vendor client for Windows/Linux/macOS plus a web console.
record.chaining: Not viable as a WG endpoint because the port is not stable.
record.limits_note: the free tunnel's random domain and TCP/UDP port are force-changed at irregular intervals
record.binding_note: 2 GB per month fails 1 TiB by a factor of about 550, and the 1 Mbps cap would fail it too: 1 Mbps sustained is roughly 0.32 TB per month.

identity_cost.detail: Registration takes a mobile phone number as the account name, a password, an email address for notifications, a nickname and an SMS verification code.

record.reliability_note: Random public port is reassigned at intervals, so any fixed endpoint stops resolving.
record.confidence_note: All three numbers are on the vendor's own pricing block. A probe would only confirm the port rotation interval.

evidence.proved: free tunnel is 1 Mbps, 2 GB per month, random port, force-changed at intervals
the free tunnel is permanently free at 1M bandwidth and 2 GB of traffic a month over http, tcp and udp, with a random domain or port force-changed at irregular intervals

record.notes: The port-insecurity sentence is the interesting part for UDP: a WG endpoint written into a conf file goes stale without notice. The nodeloc roundup separately warns each free tunnel lasts only 3 days, which contradicts the vendor's 'permanently free' label; the vendor says the tunnel persists but the address changes.

extras.wg_detail: The free tier advertises UDP tunnels on a random port; a WG handshake can be carried, but the port is reassigned at intervals, so a WG endpoint would need reconfiguration each time.
extras.volume_stated: 2 GB per month on the free tunnel.
